messages.subject: [R-sig-mediawiki] R extension 0.05
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I just put version 0.05 at the web page 
http://mars.wiwi.hu-berlin.de/mediawiki/sk/index.php/R_Extension_for_MediaWiki. 
The changes are:

- Added patch by Michael Cassin for PHP5
- More banned commands suggested by Michael Cassin
- Upload and reading of Excel CSV and plain ASCII files

Have fun

  Sigbert Klinke
